patronOf.en-US: Pope of the Second Vatican Council

prayerExcerpt.en-US: We can cooperate with you to spread the civilization of love in the world.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Possamos colaborar convosco na propagação da civilização do amor.

meta.face: A slender, ascetic man of about seventy, clean-shaven, with a long, narrow face, a high bald forehead and close dark-grey hair at the temples under the zucchetto, a pronounced aquiline nose, deep-set clear blue eyes under strong dark brows, thin lips and a grave, gentle, thoughtful expression.
meta.basis: The 1969 official portrait and other photographs: a thin, long-faced pope with an aquiline nose and deep-set light eyes, in ermine-trimmed mozzetta and apostle stole. He was the first pope to fly and to visit the Holy Land (1964).
